sources.project: ACadSharp ACIS writer issue and pull requests
sources.revision: Public issue/PR pages accessed 2026-10-20. #1150 and #1240 are open with no deployment shown; #1195 remains open.
sources.observed: #1150 describes legacy DXF group-1/3 SAT, newer DXF ACDSDATA/SAB, legacy DWG inline payloads, and modern DWG AcDs writing. Its author reported a post-#1174 reader conflict and that DXF ACDSDATA readback retained only the last group-310 line; the maintainer preferred a schema-aware writer and left the branch as a reference. #1240 is also open/undeployed and its visible ModelerGeometry serialization commit is in DwgObjectWriter. #1195 reports silent DXF omission of modeler entities, including block-contained solids.
sources.limits: PR descriptions, branch tests, and author-reported TrueView results are not released behavior or independently reproduced results. The issue reports are version/profile-specific and do not establish a libdxfrw defect.

sources.project: ACadSharp PlotSettings report and Autodesk contract
sources.revision: Issue page refreshed 2026-10-20; reporter names ACadSharp 3.6.35 and 3.6.51. Autodesk current managed reference accessed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The report describes stored group-78 zero reaching a validating setter and dropping layout objects or losing/aborting DXF reads. Autodesk specifies that the custom DPI field is used only when shade-plot resolution is Custom.
sources.limits: The peer issue is not a normative range definition. Local generated controls already exercise inactive zero, active Custom limits, record graph/identity, ASCII/Binary, and following-data survival; no new local gap was confirmed.

sources.project: ACadSharp EED and parser/writer issue reports
sources.revision: Public issue pages refreshed 2026-10-20. The #1282 report names peer master v3.8.10; #1297 names ACadSharp master v3.8.14/3.8.0; #1299 names package 3.8.0.
sources.observed: #1281 reports recursive stack exhaustion for long comment/XDATA/clip-boundary runs; #1282 reports a signed-short EED size overflow above 32767; #1297 is an AC1032 MTEXT native-open failure with unresolved cause; #1299 reports a DWG-to-DXF spline that later fails GDAL conversion without a separately evaluated expected curve in the issue body.
sources.limits: These are reporter observations, not local reproductions or universal format rules. Local EED controls use ODA's unsigned bit-short profile and cover 32767/32768/65535/65536 plus cursor alignment; other issue shapes remain routed to existing local and optional consumer owners. No attached customer files were retrieved.

sources.observed: ezdxf explicitly limits arbitrary ACIS parsing/export and loses unsupported typed ACIS records; its mesh path only handles planar faces and is not an ACIS kernel. GDAL documents DXF projection, tessellation, raw-field options, and versioned Binary-DXF reading, not full CAD-document preservation or B-rep semantics.
sources.limits: These tools answer bounded route-specific questions; neither is a universal DXF/3D semantic oracle.

sources.project: ODA specification and local source/test crosswalk
sources.revision: Repository source and generated-test owners inspected 2026-10-20. No production/test code was changed or executed for this research-only pass.
sources.observed: Local PlotSettings code stores group 78 as an integer and has generated inactive-zero/Custom-boundary controls. Local DWG EED boundary tests inspect unsigned encoded lengths, continuation, suffix alignment, and indivisible over-limit refusal. Existing PAR-07/S8 planning already separates inline/modern carriers, AcDs identity association, bytes, and semantic-body evidence.
sources.limits: Source/test inspection is not a test run, external producer result, native application result, or support qualification. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: per-format/version modeler carrier matrix with complete chunk reconstruction, block/owner identity, schema-aware AcDs association, and explicit preserve-or-refuse writer disposition
PAR-111/7BM PlotSettings owner: retain inactive group-78 zero separately from active Custom-DPI validation and preserve the rooted LAYOUT graph/suffix controls
PAR-14 parser-safety owner: retain unsigned EED count/width semantics and existing boundary/alignment tests; do not adopt the peer signed-short ceiling
Optional composed peer/native gate: pin exact artifact, route, version, options, and output disposition; do not run peers per local slice

planChanges: Updated the newest plan summary with a fresh ACadSharp ACIS-writer branch lifecycle check: #1150 is not a current/released positive after the #1174 refactor and #1240 remains undeployed; do not treat either as a resolved #1195 DXF-writer capability.

Added an implementation-ready PAR-07/S8 matrix for legacy/newer DXF and DWG carriers, complete ordered chunk reconstruction, per-source-handle/block identity, AcDs schema/index/search mapping, and no-silent-loss publication policy.

Cross-checked PlotSettings and EED reports against local generated controls; explicitly preserve inactive DPI behavior and ODA unsigned EED widths without duplicate tests or a peer-derived range limit.
Reaffirmed issue reports and GDAL/ezdxf projection/parsing as bounded comparison leads only; no customer attachment, external fixture, routine peer run, or 3D support claim is admitted.
limitations: Research inspected public issue/PR bodies and current documentation; it did not reproduce peer outputs or test the local binaries.
ACadSharp #1150/#1240 are mutable, unmerged branches. Current branch state and author comments do not establish a release capability.
No external/private/customer drawing was downloaded, and no peer package, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was run.
The six external-only J items remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; this research cannot promote their support claims.
